spec.name: WIDEN_MIX
spec.note: The added 2048 dims spread over TWO earlier depths instead of one: half of b3's channels (1024) + all of b2's (1024). D=4096, N=32, byte-matched. Answers 'is one block back enough, or is it depth?'

grouping.mixing_note: 1.0 = every well holds the global block mixture; 0.0 = every well is a single block. A low value means the joint store is two stores side by side.

byte_ledger.note: ⭐ matched bytes with the codebook at N = M: the landscape gets NO extra points and must win on the EXPONENT alone (PREREG §2).
byte_ledger.what: 32 atoms x 4096 float32 = the store, content=['p', 'b3', 'b2']
